_comment: Ground-truth transcription of the official 11x11 grid. Method: pixel grid-line detection (12 v-lines + 12 h-lines) -> per-cell ink -> glyph split -> digit classifier trained on the EXAMPLE panel's 10 known numbers (leave-one-out validation 10/10) + font-independent enclosed-hole-count feature. Generated by ocr_disambiguate.py; independently cross-checked against a human read and against DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash's independent vision read.
